question: Universal Containers has a Candidate custom object with OWD = Private. A Candidate has a lookup to a User (Interviewer). When an Interviewer is assigned, they should automatically get Read access to that Candidate record. What should be used?

options.A: Share the record using an Apex class (Apex Managed Sharing)
options.B: Share the record using a Permission Set
options.C: Share the record using a Sharing Rule
options.D: The record cannot be shared with the current setup

explanation: Sharing rules and permission sets can't share to a user stored in a lookup on each record. You must create a Candidate__Share row via Apex-managed sharing so the specific user gets record access.

question: A Lightning Web Component must run custom logic when it loads. Which method is best to use?
explanation: In LWC, connectedCallback() runs once when the component is inserted into the DOM. renderedCallback runs on every render, and Aura techniques don't apply to LWC.

question: Users of a lightning-record-edit-form only see one error message at a time. You want to validate multiple fields and show multiple errors at once with minimal JavaScript. What is recommended?
explanation: Validation rules run on save and can produce multiple error messages shown simultaneously in the standard form UI, with no custom JS needed.

question: You need to bulk-update 100k CatalogItem__c records so their Zip matches the parent Catalog__c Zip. Which approach is best?

options.A: Write a Batchable Apex that queries CatalogItem with a QueryLocator and in execute() query related Catalogs and update only changed items
options.B: Loop over all items in a single transaction and update them
options.C: Use a trigger on CatalogItem to update Zip when record is read
options.D: Use a synchronous for loop with Database.update per record

explanation: Batchable with QueryLocator scales to 100k. In each batch, query the related Catalogs once, compare zips, and update only needed records to avoid excess DML and CPU.

question: A Lightning web component calls an Apex method that returns a wrapper object. What must you add so LWC can use the method and wrapper fields?

options.B: Add @AuraEnabled to the static method only
options.C: Add @AuraEnabled to the method and to the wrapper's properties

explanation: The Apex method must be annotated @AuraEnabled and the wrapper's properties must also be @AuraEnabled so the LWC can read those fields over the wire.

question: In a Visualforce controller test, what is the correct way to set the page and pass an Account id parameter?

options.C: Insert the Account, call Test.setCurrentPage(Page.MyTestPage), then System.currentPageReference().getParameters().put('id', acct.Id);
options.D: Use seeAllData=true to access the Account

explanation: Create test data in the test, set the current VF page with Test.setCurrentPage(...), then put the id into currentPageReference parameters to simulate a real page request.

question: A method uses SOSL to find accounts with 'test' in fields. A test inserts an Account and calls the method, but the method returns no results in the test. How to fix the failing test?

options.A: @isTest(SeeAllData=true) to allow SOSL to see the inserted data
options.C: Use @testSetup method to set up data

explanation: In tests, SOSL may not find newly inserted data unless SeeAllData=true or Test.fixedSearchResults is correctly used. The exam option that fixes the failing test is SeeAllData=true (though not best practice).

question: A developer wrote an application event that caused an infinite loop in an Aura app. What likely caused the loop?

options.A: The event is fired from a custom renderer
options.B: An event fired on 'ontouchend' is unhandled
options.C: The event has multiple registrations in the project
options.D: The event handler calls a server-side trigger

explanation: Firing an application event from a custom renderer can cause rerender → event → rerender loops because renderer runs on every rerender.

question: Which three reasons are valid to write Jest unit tests for Lightning Web Components? (Choose 3)

options.B: To verify that events fire when expected
options.C: To test how multiple components work together
options.D: To verify the DOM output of a component
options.E: To test a component's non-public properties

explanation: Jest unit tests are used for user interaction, event behavior, and DOM output. Integration (how multiple components work together) is beyond unit tests; private internals should not be tested directly.

question: A Case trigger and handler increment Edit_Count__c each time a Case is changed. A new process causes the handler to run more than once, so Edit_Count__c increments multiple times per edit. Which change fixes recursion safely?

options.A: Declare a local firstRun Boolean inside the trigger and toggle it
options.B: Add a non-static Boolean firstRun in the handler class
options.C: Add a public static Boolean firstRun = true in the handler class and check it in the trigger before calling handle (do not reset it)
options.D: Reset the static flag inside the trigger after calling the handler

explanation: Use a static Boolean flag in the handler class and check it from the trigger to avoid recursive calls in the same execution context. Do not reset it inside the same transaction.

question: Which two queries are optimized for large data volumes (200k+ Account records) when there are External ID fields Customer_Number__c and ERP_Key__c? (Choose 2)

options.A: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id IN :aListVariable
options.B: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name != '' AND IsDeleted = false
options.C: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name != NULL
options.D: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name != '' AND Customer_Number__c = 'ValueA'

explanation: Queries using indexed fields (Id or External ID) are selective. Name filters and != make queries non-selective on large data volumes.

question: Which technique should be used so a Lightning web component can interact with platform events (EMP API)?
explanation: Use lightning/empApi in LWC to subscribe to streaming platform events (CometD) with subscribe/unsubscribe/onError.

question: A native iOS app needs consolidated JSON data from many Salesforce objects. What is the optimal method to implement in Salesforce?

options.C: Apex SOAP Web Service (expose Apex as SOAP)
options.D: Apex REST Web Service (expose Apex as REST)

explanation: Expose a REST Apex web service to return consolidated JSON. REST is lightweight and fits mobile app needs.

question: A developer needs to show recent interactions (orders, phone calls, or cases) on a customer record page, where 'recent' depends on the record type. Which solution is best?

options.A: Use Lightning Flow to read the record type, then do a dynamic query for recent interactions and display them on the record page
options.B: Use a Lightning component that gets record type via design attribute
options.C: Use batch Apex to query most recent interactions when the page loads
options.D: Use dynamic forms to display recent interactions

explanation: A Flow can read the record type and run the appropriate query, and be placed on the record page with minimal code. Batch Apex is not for synchronous UI queries.

question: The Contact object has workflow rules that trigger field updates but fields aren't updating. What debug log level should a developer set to see workflow rule condition values?

options.A: INFO level for the Database log category
options.B: ERROR level for the Workflow log category
options.C: ERROR level for the Database log category
options.D: INFO level for the Workflow log category

explanation: Set INFO level for Database logs to capture evaluation of workflow conditions and field values during rule evaluation.

question: A developer wants to compare the Name field of any two records such as Account vs Opportunity. What is the correct way?

options.B: Use Schema.describe() to fetch field metadata
options.C: Cast to sObject and use sObject.get('Name')
options.D: Use Metadata API to extract values

explanation: Casting records to sObject and using get('Name') is the correct way to generically access the Name field across objects.

question: A test fails with: 'Uncommitted work pending. Please commit or rollback before calling out.' What is a possible solution?

options.C: Call support for help with endpoint
options.D: Use test.isRunningTest() to skip callout during tests

explanation: Tests may not allow DML + callout in same execution unless mock callouts are used. Skipping callout with test.isRunningTest() avoids the failure.

question: UC wants ERP to create Orders in Salesforce for existing Accounts. What API method should the developer use?
explanation: The Connect API is used for creating records programmatically in Salesforce from external systems, especially where composite or structured data is involved.

question: A calculation must aggregate data from 50,000+ Contacts once nightly. Which two steps should the developer take?
explanation: The calculation must run asynchronously and be scheduled. A scheduled class can call an async method such as @future or Queueable.

question: Which two changes are required to make an Apex method usable with @wire in LWC?

options.D: Add public to the class declaration

explanation: A @wire Apex method must be public/global and annotated @AuraEnabled(cacheable=true).

question: Which component should be added to a form to display error messages in Lightning?
explanation: lightning-messages is the correct component for displaying standard error messages in Lightning Web Components and Aura.

question: A developer wants a Lightning Web Component to open in a modal dialog when invoked from a button on a record page. Which three configuration steps are required?

options.A: Add a targetConfig and set targets to lightning__RecordAction

explanation: To use the component as a record page action (modal), configure target lightning__RecordAction with actionType='screenAction'.

question: A Visualforce page loads thousands of Accounts at once and is slow. What can help?

options.A: Upload a third-party data table library as a static resource
options.B: Use JavaScript remoting to query accounts
options.C: Use standard Account List controller with pagination

explanation: Pagination reduces the number of rows rendered, improving load time significantly. Standard list controller handles pagination efficiently.

question: Users sometimes leave a text filter blank, causing slow SOQL on 5M Opportunity records. Which two techniques improve performance?

options.A: Add LIMIT to restrict returned rows
options.B: Ensure user input is not null before querying
options.C: Use with sharing on Apex class
options.D: Use SOSL instead of SOQL for text searches

explanation: LIMIT prevents massive result sets, and SOSL performs better for text searching across large datasets.

question: Which three techniques can a developer use to debug Lightning component JavaScript?
explanation: Browser dev tools, console logs, and enabling debug mode help debug JavaScript. Developer Console does not debug client-side JavaScript.

question: A company needs dynamic commission calculations for Opportunities based on line of business. When Opportunity is Closed/Won, different logic should run depending on the business unit. What should they use?

options.A: A final class with several methods

explanation: Use an interface with multiple implementing classes to apply different business-specific commission calculations.

question: A Visualforce RemoteAction method is supposed to return an Account. Which snippet correctly asserts the returned Account?

options.A: MyRemoter remote = new MyRemoter(); Account a = remote.getAccount('TestAccount'); System.assertEquals('TestAccount', a.Name);

explanation: RemoteAction methods are static; calling MyRemoter.getAccount directly is correct. The returned Account can be asserted immediately.

question: To allow an LWC to interact with platform events via EMP API, what import should be used?
explanation: The EMP API is accessed exclusively through lightning/empApi for platform events.

question: Users upload orders that must match Accounts. The process is slow because they manually export Accounts to get IDs. What two improvements help?

options.A: Ensure data in the file is sorted by order ID
options.C: Mark unique fields on Account and Order as external IDs

explanation: Sorting improves upsert matching, and using Data Loader upsert allows matching on external IDs without manually exporting IDs.

question: An ERP system sends invoices related to Accounts. Account has an External ID: ERP_Customer_ID__c. How should new Order__c records be created and linked automatically?
explanation: Order__c cannot directly match via an external ID on Account. You must lookup the Account first, then insert Order__c with its AccountId.

question: How should the <c-order> component notify the <c-order-order> component that an order has been selected?

options.D: Create and dispatch a custom event

explanation: In LWC, custom events are used for parent-child communication. Application/component events are Aura features, not LWC.

question: A trigger runs when 200 Accounts are inserted in a batch. Which limit is most likely to be exceeded?

options.A: Total number of DML statements issued
options.B: Total number of records processed by DML
options.C: Total number of SOQL queries issued
options.D: Total number of query rows retrieved

explanation: A poorly written trigger may perform DML inside loops, leading to too many DML statements in a single batch execution.

question: A Contact object has workflow rules with field updates that are not firing. To debug this, which debug log category and level should be used?
explanation: Database logs at INFO level display rule evaluation details, showing condition checks and field values.

question: A custom LWC data table loads thousands of records and is slow when filters change. What should the developer do to improve performance?

options.A: Use setStorable() to cache the Apex response
options.B: Load all records once and filter in JavaScript
options.C: Use SOSL for every filter change
options.D: Use a selective SOQL query with a custom index

explanation: setStorable() caches responses, preventing repeated Apex calls when filters toggle between previous values.

question: A set of Aura components needs to react after a user selects an Account in c:searchAccounts. Which event should the component fire?
explanation: Multiple independent components on the page must be notified. Application events broadcast to all listening components, unlike component events which go up the component tree only.

question: Convention_Attendance__c is private. Event_Reviewer__c (lookup to User) must automatically get read/write access. What is the best approach?

options.A: After Insert trigger with Apex Managed Sharing
options.B: Before Insert trigger with Apex Managed Sharing

explanation: Sharing reasons require Apex Managed Sharing. Before insert ensures the record is shared as soon as it's created without needing an additional DML operation.
A static flag prevents repeat execution within the same transaction, fixing recursion caused by workflow/Process Builder updates.

question: A large org has millions of Opportunities. Type__c is indexed but many records have NULL. Which technique maximizes performance when querying for NULL values?

options.A: Create formula to replace NULL, index it, query formula
options.B: Use two SOQL queries and merge results
options.C: Use SOSL to find NULL values
options.D: Use OR operator to check each picklist value

explanation: Queries checking for NULL often cannot use the index. Splitting queries allows Salesforce to use a selective plan for non-null values and fallback plan for NULLs.

question: A developer must change logic from connectedCallback() so a child component gets updated correctly. What should the developer change?

options.B: Use a custom event from parent

explanation: A reactive getter/setter responds immediately when property values change, ensuring child components update correctly.

question: Which is the optimal way to count millions of Opportunities for an LWC?
explanation: COUNT() is optimized server-side and returns aggregate totals without scanning all rows.

question: Which modification should be implemented when an LWC shows 'Error retrieving data' because it queries Opportunities for the current user?
explanation: cacheable=true allows wired Apex to run properly, improves performance, and fixes caching/misfire issues in UI.

question: How should a developer verify a specific Account record is being tested in a Visualforce controller test?

options.A: Instantiate page, insert Account, call System.setParentRecordId()
options.B: Insert Account in org, use setParentRecordId
options.C: Insert Account in test and set page parameter: System.currentPageReference().getParameters().put('id', acct.Id)

explanation: Setting page parameters is the correct, realistic way a VF controller receives record IDs.

question: Which callout fix prevents 'Unauthorized endpoint' errors?
explanation: Unauthorized endpoint means the callout URL is not approved. A Remote Site Setting must be added.

question: Users complain about long chains of toast messages. How can UI/UX be improved? (Choose 2)

options.B: Use an LWC to aggregate errors
options.D: Use public properties to show errors

explanation: Inline template errors and exposing error properties create cleaner UI and avoid toast overload.

question: A company integrates invoices using Customer_Number__c (External ID). What's the optimal way to implement synchronization?

options.A: Use External ID on both Account + Invoice and upsert nightly
options.B: Cross-reference table storing Salesforce Account IDs
options.D: Bulk delete invoices and recreate them

explanation: External IDs allow upsert, which simplifies matching without exporting Salesforce IDs.

question: A developer needs to verify that workflow field update conditions are being evaluated. What debug log level should be used?

options.A: INFO level for the Database log category
options.B: ERROR level for the Workflow log category
options.C: ERROR level for the Database log category
options.D: INFO level for the Workflow log category

explanation: INFO database logging shows workflow evaluation and field change checks in detail.

question: A Lightning web component invokes an Apex method that relies heavily on dynamic queries. Users notice slow performance when filters change. What should the developer do to improve performance?

options.A: Use setStorable() on the wired Apex call
options.B: Load all data once and filter in JavaScript
options.D: Use custom indexes to speed up queries

explanation: setStorable caches results and prevents repeated server calls when the same parameters are used.

question: A developer must modify code so a child component reacts to updated values correctly. What architectural change should be made?

options.B: Fire a custom event from the child

explanation: Getter/setter reactive properties ensure UI and child component updates occur when upstream values change.

question: A developer creates an Apex callout but receives: 'Unauthorized endpoint.' What is the correct fix?

options.A: Add a Remote Site Setting entry for the endpoint
options.D: Change the class modifier to global

explanation: Salesforce requires Remote Site Settings for external URLs before allowing callouts.

question: In a Visualforce page test, what is the best practice to initialize the page?
explanation: Test.setCurrentPage(Page.MyVFPage) correctly initializes the page context in a test class.

question: An LWC filters a large dataset and displays results in a custom datatable. Users complain filtering takes too long. Which performance improvement should be implemented?

options.A: Use client-side filtering after loading all results

explanation: Storable Apex caching improves responsiveness by reducing network calls, ideal for repeated queries with similar filters.

question: What is the best approach to aggregate data across 5 million Contact records once daily?
explanation: Batch Apex is required for large-scale processing, and scheduling ensures it runs nightly. @future or queueable may be used within it.

question: A Lightning component displays thousands of rows and is slow. How can performance be improved?

options.A: Use a static resource data grid
options.C: Use a standard list controller and pagination

explanation: Pagination ensures only a small set of rows is rendered at once, massively improving performance.

question: A Salesforce org has millions of Opportunities. Developers need to avoid slow queries when user input is blank. What should they do? (Choose 2)

options.B: Verify that user-provided input is non-null
options.D: Switch to SOSL for text searches

explanation: LIMIT avoids returning large query results, and SOSL is optimized for keyword searches across large datasets.

question: Users see multiple toast messages while interacting with an LWC. How can a developer improve UX? (Choose 2)

options.B: Aggregate errors in a dedicated LWC
options.D: Expose a public @api property for error messages

explanation: Inline template messages and public props provide controlled error handling without UI clutter.

question: Which two queries are considered optimized for large Account volumes? (Choose 2)

options.A: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id IN :listVar
options.B: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name != ''
options.C: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name != null
options.D: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Customer_Number__c = 'A001'

explanation: Id and External ID fields use indexes, making queries selective even in large data volumes.

question: How should an integration create Order__c records related to Accounts via an External ID ERP_Customer_ID__c?

options.C: Insert Order__c then update its AccountId

explanation: Upsert on Order__c cannot match against Account’s external ID. The integration must first resolve the Account, then insert the Order.

question: In LWC, what should be added to subscribe to platform events?
explanation: Platform event streaming is available only through lightning/empApi.

question: What recommendations make the import of Orders related to Accounts more efficient? (Choose 2)

options.A: Ensure the import file is sorted
options.C: Define external IDs on Order and Account

explanation: Sorting improves matching efficiency, and upsert avoids manually retrieving Account IDs beforehand.

question: What event should an Aura search component fire so multiple independent components update after an Account is selected?
explanation: Application events notify many unrelated components on the page, unlike component events which only travel up the component tree.

question: A Case trigger increments Edit_Count__c. Recursion happens because of Process Builder. Which fix prevents multiple increments?

options.A: Use a static Boolean flag in the handler class
options.B: Use a non-static Boolean variable in the trigger
options.C: Use a static list to track edited case IDs
options.D: Move logic to a batch class

explanation: A static Boolean runs once per transaction and prevents recursive re-entry caused by workflow or PB updates.

question: What is the best practice to initialize a Visualforce page in a test class?
explanation: Correct approach is Test.setCurrentPage(Page.YourVFPage).

question: Universal Containers wants Event_Reviewer__c (lookup to User) to automatically gain read/write access to Convention_Attendance__c records (OWD = Private). Which is best?

options.A: After insert trigger with Apex managed sharing
options.B: Before insert trigger with Apex managed sharing

explanation: Sharing must be applied on insert, and before insert avoids a second DML operation.

question: A developer created a Jest test for an LWC with conditional child components. How should visibility scenarios be properly tested?

options.A: Reset DOM after each test using afterEach
options.C: Use a new describe block for each scenario
options.D: Create a new jsdom instance for each test

explanation: Separate describe blocks create isolated environments for independent UI-condition tests.

question: A Salesforce org has millions of Opportunities and many Type__c values are NULL. How should performance be maximized when querying for NULL?

options.A: Create a formula replacing NULL and index it
options.B: Run two separate queries and merge results
options.D: Use OR operator to check all picklist values

explanation: NULL queries cannot use custom indexes reliably; breaking the query into two allows Salesforce to use selective plans where possible.

question: A Visualforce page is used in a community and internally. How should a developer test record sharing enforcement?

options.A: Use System.profileId() to test as admin and community user
options.B: Use System.profileId() to test as sales rep and community user
options.C: Use System.runAs() to simulate sales rep and community user
options.D: Use System.runAs() to simulate admin and community user

explanation: runAs enforces sharing rules, allowing testing of different user profiles and record access.

question: A Lightning record-edit-form only shows one validation error at a time. How can the developer show multiple errors and validate multiple fields?
explanation: External JS libraries like validate.js allow multi-field client-side validations, showing multiple errors at once.

question: An iOS app needs JSON responses from Salesforce combining multiple objects. What is the optimal solution?
explanation: Apex REST web services allow Salesforce to expose JSON-formatted aggregated data for mobile applications.

question: A developer receives an Unauthorized Endpoint error for a callout. What must be done?

options.A: Add a Remote Site Setting entry
options.D: Change class from public to global

explanation: Unauthorized endpoint means Salesforce has blocked the URL. Remote Site Settings must explicitly whitelist it.

question: A Lightning component uses a button to save changes and navigate to another page, but navigation doesn't happen. Which debugging techniques should be used? (Choose 3)

options.B: Enable Debug Mode for Lightning components

explanation: Client-side issues require browser-based debugging, debug mode, and console logs. Apex tools won't show LWC JS errors.

question: Which Apex approach allows different commission calculation implementations to be invoked when Opportunity becomes Closed/Won?
explanation: Interfaces with multiple implementations allow plug-and-play business logic per line-of-business.

question: A developer must ensure users without Pro access cannot see a dashboard. What concept does this represent?
explanation: Gatekeeping = restricting access until conditions (like Pro access) are met.

question: A Lightning web component is wired to an Apex method but returns errors. What should you update in Apex?
explanation: Wired methods must be cacheable=true for UI data consistency and reactivity.

question: Which SOQL query retrieves ALL Account fields for 'Acme'?

options.B: SELECT ALL FROM Account WHERE Name='Acme'
options.C: SELECT FIELDS FROM Account WHERE Name='Acme'
options.D: SELECT FIELDS(ALL) FROM Account WHERE Name='Acme'

explanation: FIELDS(ALL) retrieves all fields safely and is supported in sandbox and development orgs.

question: Which technique allows an Apex method to be used with @wire in an LWC?
explanation: Apex wired methods must be public/global and annotated @AuraEnabled(cacheable=true).
